description: Minimal Phase 0 contract for semantic / landmark memory items.

fields.id: Stable string id for a memory item.
fields.semantic_label: Object or landmark label, e.g. sofa.
fields.semantic_embedding: Optional frozen text / visual embedding id or vector reference.
fields.bev_position: Two-element grid coordinate [x, y] in allocentric BEV memory.
fields.last_seen_time: Integer timestamp of latest confirming observation.
fields.status: One of active, stale, missing, relocated.
fields.source_view_ids: List of observation ids that support this memory item.
